Protocol Q - Burns

Protocol cds protocol hormonal support

Evidence: Grade B (traditional_use)

Summary

Hormonal support protocol using CDS for endocrine conditions and hormonal balance.

Indications

  • Burn treatment

Steps

  1. Prepare hormonal support dose
  2. Follow support protocol
  3. Monitor hormonal symptoms

Expected Outcomes

  • Endocrine balance
